title: Trying to leave but I can’t
content: I go to Mall World every night in my dreams but for the past month or so every time I’m there I am instantly trying to leave but I am trapped there. I wait for a train that never comes, I wait for a plane that never arrives, I stand on the dock and wait for a boat that doesn’t show up. I stress about tickets, departure times and delays. There have been several times I have made it onto the aircraft/ship/plane and right after boarding there is some problem and we have to go straight back to mall world. Ugh mall world why are you so confusing
